command_line:
mkdir work
tar -xf /jetstream2/scratch/main/jobs/79033822/inputs/dataset_689992c8-3b91-470d-b9ef-aabde3024af8.dat -C work
printf '%s\n' rs41302905 rs7853989 rs1053878 rs8176720 rs2519093 rs579459 rs8176743 rs8176719 rs8176746 rs8176747 > markers.txt
plink2 --pfile work/match.genotypes.1.1 --extract markers.txt --export A --out target
plink2 --pfile work/match.genotypes.1.3 --extract markers.txt --export A --out reference
{
 echo TARGET_RAW
 cat target.raw
 echo TARGET_LOG
 cat target.log
 echo REFERENCE_RAW
 cat reference.raw
 echo REFERENCE_LOG
 cat reference.log
} > report.txt
